design_bible: Project: an existing Chinese slime companion and homestead game. Redesign art direction named 林间绘本. Cross-platform neutral mobile game, 2D hand-painted gouache background with subtle paper grain, rounded forms and carefully shaded front-facing building facades; orthographic elevated top-down ground with screen-aligned x/y axes, never a diamond/isometric island. Ground fills the viewport. Moss and fern greens #78916B #A7BB84, warm cream #F5EAD6, weathered honey wood #A98057, terracotta roof #BB795F, muted teal pond #82B7AC, charcoal olive text #334B3D. Selective warm amber glow only in lanterns/windows. Readable silhouettes, broad quiet color masses, low texture on floor and stronger brush detail on object edges, no repeated V-shaped grass pattern. One fixed sun upper left, short soft cast shadows lower right. Same cottage: compact cream plaster walls, rounded terracotta gabled shingle roof, brown arched door centered, one warm rectangular side window, tiny potted flowers and stone doorstep. Branch-and-plank facilities with restrained curved trim and canvas awnings, credible construction, not mushroom houses. Slimes must preserve existing plump low dome silhouette and two small upright black oval eyes, tiny faint mouth, one large upper-left pale highlight, golden honey body; do not add limbs, ears, costumes or a different species. Small slimes sized about half doorway height. Landscape is one continuous coherent homestead; open lawn for placement, connected paths, tiny growing plots, pond and tree clusters framing margins. No arbitrary new mechanics. UI uses opaque parchment cream, dark olive lettering, restrained warm wood edges and small custom filled hand-painted icons, never brown ornate RPG frames. Calm navigation and comfortably readable simplified Chinese; no tiny text. For phone images: one centered front-facing slim matte graphite generic phone, same device geometry across series, subtle visible bezel, no perspective tilt, consistent ivory outer canvas with balanced margins, content is hero. Six main bottom tabs exactly 陪伴 家园 召唤 探索 背包 成长, 家园 selected. Portrait composition 1024x1536 if possible, phone fills most height; no surrounding explanatory copy. For map and asset sheets, omit device frame.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished portrait mobile game home-screen concept for the existing slime homestead game, not a board. Reimagine the environmental artwork substantially.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for current phone UI content and original slime character identity; input image 2 is ONLY a reference for the existing top-down coordinate convention and the original slime. Do not reproduce their flat vector environment.

Composition: the playable hand-painted courtyard occupies about 75 percent of the phone screen. One cottage just above center, open lawn in front, a modest seedbed left, flowering pot shelf near the house, a small wooden crafting awning at lower-left, pond at right edge, layered trees around top and corners, path continuing off-screen. Organic landscape organization and intentional open grass, believable scale; lush but not busy. Same recognizable honey slime rests by the path, a second in garden; never make them huge.
UI: clean status-safe region; compact parchment top bar with title 家园 on left and coin icon 2,000 plus Lv.1 on right; beneath it one compact resource strip with custom painted material icons and numbers 662 710 800 7; a small legible time line 春季 · 第 1 日  晴. Essential screen space stays clear. At lower right small paired zoom buttons + and −. Above bottom global tabs, a low, single cream tool dock with clear large labels 建造 种植 采集 and a more button •••. Bottom navigation exactly six items 陪伴 家园 召唤 探索 背包 成长 with custom illustrated icons and 家园 visibly selected. All type large enough for a normal phone, high contrast, no explanatory paragraphs, no decorative microcopy. Keep all device edges visible and equal generous surrounding ivory margins.
The result must look like an actual beautifully illustrated cozy game interface: spatially playable, visually inviting, polished art direction, not a SaaS dashboard. Do not use isometric geometry, pixel art, low-poly 3D, shiny clay houses, generic stock icons, glassmorphism, oversaturated greens or a vignette that hides the play area.

Paint these thumbnails in the same view and texture as the in-world props, not generic icons. Short legible Chinese item names, only a tiny wood-material icon and readable 12 or 18 under each. 花架 is selected with a restrained moss green outline, other objects unboxed. The upper live scene remains visible and unobscured enough to identify cottage, lawn and pond; no heavy black scrim.

prompts.prompt:

Create ONE large landscape 3:2 full-map environmental art concept for the SAME slime homestead shown in the reference. The reference is a visual identity/style reference only, not a target to crop. The final image must be a fresh complete continuous map, NO phone, NO interface, NO labels, NO text, NO legends, NO graphic frame.

Whole playable map proportion is 36 units wide by 24 high; screen-aligned horizontal and vertical axes and front-facing cottage, orthographic top-down ground. Fill the rectangular image with terrain; no horizon, no floating island, no diamond shape, no perspective convergence. Elevate the viewpoint enough to understand path connectivity. Use the exact warm gouache woodland style of the reference with cleaner, quieter lawns; trees in clusters frame the edges but do not cover the useful central land.
Spatial composition: the familiar cream-walled terracotta-roof cottage is the central visual anchor slightly above center; a small L-shaped vegetable garden northwest; short flower shelves, bench and lanterns by the cottage; wooden crafting awning and modest stone kiln southwest; a feeding table and tiny toy corner southeast; a pond with clear muted teal water, stones, reeds and a short wooden footbridge in the eastern quarter. Paths connect the cottage, garden, workshop, pond and exits into ONE navigable loop, made from soft-edged stone, earth and short wooden boardwalk sections. Paths follow screen-aligned horizontal/vertical segments with rounded corners and slight hand-painted natural irregularity, not sharp grid stamps or diagonal isometric intersections. A small orchard cluster at west edge, mixed deciduous trees and shrubs at top and bottom edge. At least one-third of the whole map is broad quiet buildable grassy clearings connected to paths, so it feels playable and expandable, with groupings of flowers instead of noisy texture everywhere.
Four small original honey dome-shaped slimes wander through paths and garden at consistent scale, using the reference silhouette, black oval eyes, highlight and minimal face. No other humanoids. A few ecological details only, butterflies and one bird.
Map asset consistency: same front-lit terracotta shingle roof, honey timber and cream canvas as reference, upper-left sunlight, soft lower-right shadows, readable tree silhouettes, subtle painted ground. Quiet bright afternoon. Cozy and beautifully art-directed, legible as a real homestead map at small size.

prompts.prompt:

Warm ivory background. Calm, carefully aligned layout with a readable Chinese title 地表与小径 and SIX distinct large SQUARE ground swatches in an evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row grid. Each swatch is a flat top-down patch of terrain framed only by its square footprint, not a floating isometric block; no thickness, soil cutaway, shadows underneath or perspective tilt. Swatches have softly feathered edges into the ivory. Each shows a 90-degree turn in a short continuous path and the same moss green grass along its sides. This is a MATERIAL STYLE STUDY, not a claim of mathematically seamless tiles. Large readable labels underneath each swatch; exact labels in reading order:
碎石小径, 苔石小径, 木板步道, 白砂路, 落叶路, 星砂路.
Swatch 1: warm limestone irregular flat pavers, a few tiny gravel pieces, clear readable joining pattern, cream stone rather than muddy dirt.
Swatch 2: cooler gray-green flat stones, deep moss in joins, sparse small clover by edge, distinct from swatch 1.
Swatch 3: honey-colored wooden walkway boards with restrained woodgrain, straight planks turn cleanly 90 degrees, no rails.
Swatch 4: pale ivory sand path with delicate fine grain, smooth rounded borders and tiny sparse pebbles.
Swatch 5: warm russet and ochre leaves concentrated along an earth trail, subdued saturation and distinct leaf silhouettes, not a red carpet.
Swatch 6: subtle deep slate-teal sand with a few softly luminous warm cream star-like grains, moss grass border consistent with other swatches; refined magical sparkle, no neon, no purple.
Below the six swatches a compact unlabelled horizontal strip of four smaller material examples in wide rectangles: quiet grassy lawn, brown cultivated garden earth with three tiny seedlings, still muted teal pond water with one lily pad, natural stone-and-reed pond shoreline joining grass to water. These show how basic terrain blends and match the map reference.
Gouache brushwork and tactile matte surfaces, comfortable white space, consistent light, highly readable at small size. Do not add color hex codes, English copy, measurement lines, arrows, additional labels or decorative borders. Avoid excessive microtexture. The six path materials must be clearly distinguishable without breaking the common art style.
